subject: backboardd Metal: device-creation race vs GPU ready (root cause) + CA decision tree
body:
Follow-up (human: OFF image also solid). QuartzCore 16.7 unslid: CA::OGL::new_context 0x1885076d0 -> pref CAEnableMetalWhippet (default on) -> get_metal_device 0x18838421c (=MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice) -> MetalContext ctor 0x188487e28; nil device or ctor NULL => silent SW fallback 0x188507a90. SW vtable: 66/110 slots default stubs (no Metal blur pipelines) so OFF=solid is consistent.
ROOT CAUSE (strong, partly inferred): device-creation race. Nord2GPU::start registers service + MetalPluginName immediately; ready flips later in tick() (waiting-pmic-owner->powerOn). UI log: backboardd open Nord2GPU at line 1771 (t<=23.27s); NORD2 GPU ready=1 at lines 1851-1860 (t~23.6-23.7s); same order in first UI run (1768 vs 1844). TeguComputeDevice init -> scalar(0) -> n2mb capabilities() needs status.powered&&arch_ok (nord2_metal_bridge.c:112) -> NOTREADY -> goto fail -> nil. MTLAddDevice never runs, device array empty, MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice returns nil, CA uses SW. SpringBoard opens 7s later and works. Explains missing background/gpu priority markers, zero buffers.
Ctor conditions (all otherwise satisfied in source): newCommandQueue + [queue device]==device (TeguQueue ok); newLibraryWithURL default.metallib 1014944B (nil => CA abort); MobileGestalt ChipID!=0xFE00 => newPipelineLibraryWithFilePath default.pipelinelib via inherited Apple _MTLDevice (not overridden: risk); queries supportsFamily 1001/1002 true,1003/1005/2002 false, maxColorAttachments 2, tile shaders/memoryless false via initFeatureQueries(featureProfile=UINT64_MAX).
MINIMAL CHANGES: (1 compute, compute_frontend.m initWithAcceleratorPort) bounded retry (20ms, ~5s) of scalar(0) on NOTREADY; host test fake transport NOTREADY xN then OK, and never-ready bounded nil. Optional kernel: defer MetalPluginName/registerService until ready. (2 render) nil PSO/encoder must go before enabling: QuartzCore aborts on build-pipeline failure (0x188381ef4) and RenderBox crashes on nil encoder. (3 compute) override newPipelineLibraryWithFilePath:error: => nil+NSError. (4 root) gate backboardd Metal (boot-arg) until (2) done, else backboardd crash loop.
STARTUP PIPELINES (default.metallib 141 fns: 39 vertex, 95 fragment, 7 kernel; WarmupShaders builds descriptors up to 6 MTLPixelFormats; on-demand create_vertex/fragment_shader): std/fixed_vert+fixed_frag(_spc/_gen), path_* (rect,cubic,stroke*,blit,clear), blur (downsample_blur, narrow_blur_7..27, single_pass_blur_3, variable_blur, upsample, asg), shading (axial/radial/conic), alpha_threshold, display_overdrive_*, harmony, home_affordance_base, edr_scale, luma_boost, p3_clamp, attachment_clear, inplace_copy, apply_apl_dimming; compute: compute_apl, compute_apl_fast, sum_apl_and_compute_dimming_factor (tile_downsample only if tile shaders). Ledger (mostly stale compiler 57db4be4): path_* 28 base_instance aborts, ~34 varyings pairing refusals, inplace_copy storage image, fixed_*_gen reflection - all would be nil today.
